modos.descricao: Recruta temporariamente inimigos do HG, compra combat cards bônus

params.descricao: Recruta ate 10 Renome de inimigos do Hunting Grounds temporariamente. Compra +1 combat card por inimigo recrutado. Dura 1 combate. Once per game.

_metadata.texto_original: The Gift user can create a temporary pack out of enemies in the Hunting Grounds. Up to 10 Renown worth of enemies can be brought into the pack. You may draw 1 additional combat card per enemy recruited. This lasts for 1 combat only. Allies Below may be used only once per game.
